notes: #206 wgpu depth instrument fill: qwen3.5-9B's served path is wgpu (backend_select::QWEN35_DENSE_NO_CUDA; cuda serving is opt-in) yet the family's only wgpu rows are shallow GEN-ARM cells (ig1 nvfp4 116.0 tok/s, bf16 base 79.5 tok/s at prefill_tokens=5) and its published deep cell was withdrawn, not corrected; this ladder lands the wgpu serving shape at 256/8k/196608, the ctx196k conformance rung shared with the g4moe depth rows
rationale: The wgpu serving decode for this family is Decoder::step -> Qwen3_5DenseWgpu::decode_step, device argmax with no host logits row: chat_engine_wgpu builds via from_loader_with_lora arming nothing, the spec chain route admits only gemma4-e4b by default (SPEC_KINDS_DEFAULT_IS_GEMMA4_E4B_ALONE), and MTP is the NV_Q3D_MTP=1 opt-in -- so bare-defaults {} IS the served configuration and the spec stays single-arm; the eleven-arm QWEN35_DENSE stack in chat_engine/build.rs belongs to the NV_QWEN35_DENSE_CUDA_SERVE opt-in cuda path and never applies on wgpu. Single-arm spec, so no null pair owed; the shallow rungs double as continuity checks against the GEN-ARM rows. depths_per_run=true because the decoder module is the one the qwen38 wgpu instrument runs one depth per process (the #96 residual race). Coverage fill, not an adjudication: rows land as labeled facts about the unarmed served path and no margin is quoted from this spec. #244's quality-null half for the family stays open and is not discharged here.
